method: executed, not asserted: a real 597-record Scopus export (46 columns, from the EmbedSLR example corpus) was parsed by parse_csv_export, written back by to_scopus_csv, re-parsed, and the written file imported by bibliometrix::convert2df
defect_found_and_fixed: parse_csv_export mapped no affiliation column in any dialect, so 595 of 597 records lost their addresses on import from file. bibliometrix derives C1 -> AU_UN from that column, so the institutional collaboration network returned 'Matrix is empty!!' (0 x 0). The Record.affiliations field existed but only the API clients populated it. After adding the column to all six dialect maps and splitting on '; ': 592/597 carry affiliations and the network resolves to 986 institutions.
supersedes: an earlier note claimed a 14,302-record run with 31,984 authors; no such export or metrics file exists on this machine and the figure was withdrawn as unsupported
